g.text: Standard deviation is a length scale — not a point
Face-on views of the SAME zero-mean plane H. v₁ and v₂ are orthonormal directions within it, not individuals.
A has length √2 and SD 1; C has length 0.65.
All sample SDs are 1. This is NOT a unit circle.
All lengths are 1. Points encode direction, not SD.
